title: Filtering and search
description: Add filter controls to the bugs list page: dropdowns for status, priority, and assignee. Implement client-side filtering with a Clear Filters button that resets all filters.
designContext: Filter controls are rendered above the bug list. Three dropdowns: status (all/open/in-progress/resolved/closed), priority (all/critical/high/medium/low), assignee (all/dynamic from data). Filtering is client-side -- fetch all bugs then filter in JS. Clear Filters button resets all dropdowns to 'all'.
